notes.title: Update 1.1 ! Clean animals and bug fixes !
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.1 - Time to clean !  [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34278766/107265d968d91f9048c53ed9d9427619fd702cad.gif[/img]

First of all, thanks all of you ! We have already over 150 farmer's that joined  the adventure !

[b]Feature Added :[/b]
[list]
[*] We can now clean the animals ! They gets dirty walking around everywhere ! Grab a sponge and clean them in order to get a reward ! ːsteamhappyː
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes : [/b]
[list]
[*]You can bring back lost animals with teleport mode
[*] Bring player back to begining if falls under the map 
[*]Teleport orientation with Htc Vive is now correct 
[*]Rotate while in teleport mode 
[*]Throw away trash with teleport
[*]Pig where in holiday for few days, they are back ! 
[/list]

[b]- Upcoming feature for 1.2 : [/b]Ridding horse & Mixed Reality Support

You can chat directly with me on Discord or Facebook ! See you !

[i]Fun VR Farm-[/i]

notes.title: Update : Teleport & Key Binding Infos
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone ! [/b]

[u]The game has been updated : [/u]

- You can now switch locomotion from Touchpad/Joystick to VR Teleport.
- Bindings info can be found in the Menu and "Controls"

[i] Thank you for playing, and have a good day at the farm ! [/i][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34278766/766eee8b7f6f932447cb1cd3081cb6cfc28525e2.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update on the way !
notes.content:
